review_finding.details: Slot 1 accepts any loader different from slot 0 when request identity_sha256 matches. currentPaused only requires a context recorded for that loader. A previously observed stale main-frame loader with the same request identity can therefore satisfy the current slot even after activeLoader has advanced.
review_finding.reproduction: A lightweight in-memory CDP event probe observed contexts and navigations for old, stale, then current loaders; after filling slot 0 with old, it emitted a matching target response from stale. currentPaused resolved with paused[1].loader_id='stale' while activeLoader='current'.
review_finding.impact: A false current-document classification can pass the loader/context gate and misidentify which response was released, undermining request-to-document binding.
